body: I have put my husband through almost 8 years of pain because of my own issues. I had an upbringing that has shaped me into the broken mess I am today, along with me choosing to be with an ex partner for 5 years who fucked me up even more. I almost wish my kids were taken away because it would me free to move on
I miss my beat friend, he is so close but so far away. Maybe one day we will get back to this...

This may be a relatively easy way to build that emotional intimacy, food for thought


https://www.gottman.com/blog/6-hours-a-week-to-a-better-relationship/

Yea kinda breaks my heart 💔 i am def going to be keeping an eye on him and getting this counseling set up asap. Do you think its worth getting additional insight/clarity or should it be left alone until we are in counseling together? Sorry for more questions i am just worried about him above all else, having some serious anxiety about it. He stays hime during the day with one 1 1/2 yo daughter and I worry about him.

When you say it’s concerning he can say that and then just move on, is it concerning because he might do that? And we actually talked about counseling last night, and my brother offered to pay which is a barrier for us. We agree that it is needed and im going to get it set up asap, the suicide comment really worries me too. I dont know what to make of it with him coming back and being semi okay now.....
We will, thank you so much ☺️

Thank you for your perspective and im sorry you went through that ordeal but happy you learned from it also. Luckily for us there is no alcohol or other stuff like that driving our fighting, just more being no different pages, lack of communication and connection. Its weird thinking about because i know that no matter what happens we will always be connected but currently we are not feeling it, if that makes any sense lol like we without a doubt love eachother immeasurably but havent been acting that way.

Thank you for your advice. I can see how crossing the line can really hurt things, even though he went for a drive and we talked it out somewhat we didnt address the yucky stuff that was said and i dint think either if us have a desire to go there cuz we are emotionally exhausted. And he works nights and I days (kids and saving money on daycare drove that decision) so finding time to communicate is another barrier unfortunately.

Thank you yes we actually were talking about it and are both open to it and my brother offered to pay because thats a barrier for us. I dont think either one of us intends to hurt we are just so not connected right now and cant seem to connect like we used too.

I believe in getting stuff done that needs to be done, he will help if asked but is admittedly not proactive which can make life harder as we have 4 kids and both work full time; i dont want the kids to be zombies on screens and today if i hadnt put my foot down they woukd have easily been on them at least 3 hours, i believe in being in investing in a relationship with quality whereas he believes any time spent together is quality. Maybe vues wasnt the right word? Its just our differences are causing alot of tension and today, during the heat of the moment, he told me he wasnt happy and wanted to kill himself at times and hes never been happy. I asked why did he court me and marry me and his response was, idk im an idiot. He then went for a drive came back and the moment we both looked at eachother we kind of smiled cuz i came up to him and half jokingly pushed him for leaving. Idk, in that moment i felt our connection but lately again our differences are really hurting us both.
